about.title: Built around real workshop work, not stock promises.
paragraphs: What started as a long-running obsession with vintage sound became a practical workshop service. The focus is simple: make each player reliable, safe to use and honest about what has been replaced or preserved.
Alongside repair work, restored machines are prepared for sale with clear descriptions and current photographs so buyers know exactly what they are getting.
